name: Khulna District Police — SP office and thanas
attribution: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Khulna (police.khulna.gov.bd) and the thana portals
notes: No licence stated. police.khulna.gov.bd publishes no thana list, thana count or contact table (its 'এক নজরে' describes the office building; 'ডাক যোগাযোগ' gives no street address); SP office from the Superintendent's officer card, thanas from the 9 upazila thana portals' officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Dacope's thana portal is police.dacope.khulna.gov.bd (police.dakop.khulna.gov.bd fails the TLS handshake). Khulna city is policed by KMP (KHULNA_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026).
